summary: Retested customer_master Google Sheet sync after main agent renamed the sheet header 'customer_ pin' -> 'customer_pin' and ran POST /api/integrations/customer-master/sync?force=true. All PIN-related assertions now pass. 9/10 tests green; 1 failure is a stale expectation in the review request (see below), not a real regression.

minor.issue: _meta.source is 'apps_script' (not 'public_sheet' as the review request expected). This is because CONTENT_PROVIDER=auto and APPS_SCRIPT_URL is now configured, so AppsScriptProvider precedes PublicSheetProvider in services/content/service.py. Content itself is served correctly (200 with full business fields). Expectation appears stale after enabling Apps Script for customer_master sync.

action_items: Decide whether GET /api/content/business should still report _meta.source=='public_sheet'. If yes, either set CONTENT_PROVIDER=public_sheet in backend/.env, or reorder providers in services/content/service.py so PublicSheetProvider is tried before AppsScriptProvider for the business tab. Otherwise, update the acceptance criteria to allow 'apps_script'.
critical_code_review_comments: services/content/service.py: provider order is driven purely by insertion order; adding a new integration silently switches the reported _meta.source. Consider making per-tab provider preference explicit (e.g., business tab always public_sheet, customer_master always apps_script) to prevent this coupling.

services/customer_master.py COLUMNS is the backend contract; adding a lightweight startup diff against the live sheet header (GET action=getHeaders) would prevent silent typos like the previous 'customer_ pin' regression.
seed_data_creation: Registered 1 QA user (qa.pin.<ts>@example.org, CUST-000009+). Sheet row NOT deleted per instructions. Mongo user cleaned (deletedCount=1). Existing sheet rows CUST-000002 (pin 700045) and CUST-000006 (pin 411027) verified backfilled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The customer_pin sync bug is fully fixed. Sheet header is now 'customer_pin' (no space); backfill applied; new registrations + PUT /api/auth/me both propagate PIN to the same row within ~6s. Only pending item is the content-source expectation mismatch above — trivial config/ordering decision.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the original PIN gap was a stray space in the Google Sheet header cell ('customer_ pin'), while backend COLUMNS in services/customer_master.py wrote key 'customer_pin'. Apps Script upsertRow_ matches headers exactly, so pin was dropped for every row. Mitigation applied by main agent: renamed the sheet header to 'customer_pin' and executed POST /api/integrations/customer-master/sync?force=true which re-upserted all rows. Verified: CUST-000002 pin=700045, CUST-000006 pin=411027, new qa.pin.<ts> registration pin=700055, subsequent PUT /api/auth/me {pin:'700045'} updated same row to 700045.
